description: This file defines the PermissionsManager class, which manages runtime permissions in an Android application. It handles permission checks, requests, user opt-in persistence, and provides utilities for opening app settings and requesting permissions via Activity Result APIs.

classes.name: PermissionsManager
classes.description: Handles runtime permission management, including checks, requests, user opt-in persistence, and navigation to app settings.

methods.name: setUserOptIn
methods.description: Stores the user's opt-in decision for a specific permission group.

methods.name: isUserOptedIn
methods.description: Retrieves whether the user has opted in to a specific permission group.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of permissions for a group, including granted, permanently denied, and previous request info.

methods.name: openAppSettings
methods.description: Opens the system settings screen for manual permission management.

methods.name: buildRequestLauncher
methods.description: Creates an ActivityResultLauncher for requesting permissions, with a callback indicating success.

methods.name: requestGroupPermissions
methods.description: Requests all permissions associated with a specific group, marking the request as made.

methods.name: isAnyCriticalPermissionMissing
methods.description: Checks if any critical permissions (Location or Media) are missing, useful for gating features.

properties.name: prefs
properties.description: SharedPreferences instance for persisting user choices and request flags.

constants.name: PREFS_NAME
constants.description: SharedPreferences name used for storing permission-related data.

enum.name: PermissionGroup
enum.description: Defines permission groups like LOCATION, MEDIA, and SMS for managing permissions collectively.

data_classes.name: PermissionStatus
data_classes.description: Data class representing the status of permissions for a group, including granted, permanentlyDenied, and requestedBefore flags.
